notes.title: Acknowledgements and Hyperchaos begins...
notes.content:
[p][b]Hello everyone![/b][/p][p][/p][p]I want to thank everyone who picked up [i]Impact Trial: First Encounter[/i] during the recent sale. I truly hope that if you play it, you enjoy it as much as I did creating it. And if you do, feel free to leave a review — I’d love to know what you think![/p][p][/p][p]I also want to share that I’ve been working for a few months on a much more arcade-style version of [i]First Encounter[/i], titled [b]Hyperchaos[/b]. It’s a full reimagining of the original, adding a real-time adaptive difficulty mode, Steam leaderboards, new achievements, and more.[/p][p][/p][p]I’d bet both my hands that if you enjoyed [i]First Encounter[/i], or if you haven't played it yet but you love competitive bullet hell games, [b]you’re going to love [i]Hyperchaos[/i][/b]. And if you’re still unsure, just add it to your wishlist — that helps me a lot, and who knows, it might win you over with time![/p][p][/p][p]Impact Trial: Hyperchaos -> [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3755540/Impact_Trial_Hyperchaos/" style="button"]Add to Wishlist[/url][/p][p][/p][p]When will it be released?[b] [/b]I'm aiming for the last quarter of this year… so it won’t be long now![/p][p][/p][p]Thanks for being here and for being part of this journey. See you very soon… in the Hyperchaos.[/p][p][/p][p]Best,[/p][p]Manuel Bacallado[/p][p]
[/p]

notes.title: Ultimate Update
notes.content:
Hello!

First of all, I would like to thank you if you have played [b]Impact Trial: First Encounter[/b].

In a few days it will be 6 months since its release, and I wanted to make a "ultimate update" with the following changes:

[list]
[*] [b]Now you can go beyond the edges of the screen, even more retro![/b]
[*] [b]You can choose between automatic shooting or normal shooting.[/b]
[*] [b]The combat system has been optimized so that it doesn't consume so many computational resources.[/b]
[/list]

With this, I say goodbye to [b]Impact Trial: First Encounter[/b] and the journey to the next game begins. I only hope that if you have played it at the beginning, at the moment I am writing this, or in the future, you have enjoyed it as much as I have enjoyed creating it.

I only ask one thing, if you play [b]Impact Trial: First Encounter[/b], please leave a review, it will help to spread the word about the game. I will thank you from the bottom of my heart.

Thanks for playing the game!
Nothing more to add,
Best regards,
